tasks.short: Order library materials and make payments.

steps.what: Check the authorised print or non-print material selection, actual supplier prices, format, edition and availability
Figure the order cost from actual quantities, prices, discounts, tax and delivery charges and reconcile the budget
Prepare the actual library order slip or supplier order payload with the checked items, cost and delivery details
Check and approve the exact completed order package v1, edition, licence terms, total, authority limit and supplier destination
Send the exact approved library order package v1 to the approved supplier
Match the actual invoice and receipt to the order, resolve differences and prepare and check the exact payment amount, payee account and reference
Release the exact approved payment payload v1 to the verified supplier payee within existing payment authority

tasks.design: Configure the library acquisitions module in {OTHER} to reuse selected record IDs and actual supplier price fields, calculate explicit charge terms and render the order slip. The technician checks the completed order before sending; actual invoice/receipt reconciliation, payment preparation and the separate gated {BANK} release retain their effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prices, arithmetic and order slips may be copied across supplier and local records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native acquisitions fields, cost rules and order templates can reuse checked lines.
tasks.still_hard: Edition/licence errors, invoice differences and payee verification need accountable checks.
tasks.human_edge: Notice that an apparently equivalent item or licence does not meet the selection.

ambition.what: No extra procurement or payment authority.

tasks.altitude: Less order transcription; selection checks and payment responsibility stay unchanged.

reach.learn: Edition, access and licence requirements behind a selection

evidence.claim: Native library acquisitions modules can reuse material records, calculate explicit costs and produce order forms.

assumptions: Boundary includes the technician's ordering and payments, with existing delegated authority. If finance or a second signatory is required its labour stays with that role and is not credited as saved. Shares are provisional.

The librarian supplies existing authorised item IDs/edition/format/quantities; suppliers supply actual unit price, currency, discount, tax and freight; the budget owner supplies available budget and limits. The technician checks missing fields manually in s1-s2, not with invented prices.

Native configuration is tested before custom integration. Missing supplier feeds use manually checked price entry within s1; claimed cuts cover repeated search/copy and arithmetic, not missing-data resolution.

Supplier invoices and existing receipt evidence arrive after ordering; s6 checks actual quantities received and verified payee data, not planned receipt. A disputed or unreceived charge is not automatically paid.
{OTHER} is the library acquisitions system. Each complete payload exists before its approval, edits void approval, sends/payment actions are separate and unchanged. Runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Current acquisitions module coverage and payment delegation
research_questions: Which ordering steps still involve manual copying between supplier quotes and acquisitions records?

already_counted.description: Check actual material and supplier price matches
Actual invoice, receipt and payment-payload checking

incremental.description: Maintain supplier field mappings, charge rules and order templates

approvals.approved_version: payment payload v1 and verified payee

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central 8.75 price-navigation plus 12 costing plus 12 order-preparation points less 2 upkeep = 30.75. High rounds down. Low assumes poor supplier field coverage and bespoke licences leave most copying manual; receipt checking and payment work are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Identify actual lost or overdue loans and check current returns, due dates, patron contacts and notice suppression rules
Prepare each actual overdue or lost-book notice from the checked loan details and approved wording
Check the exact completed notice batch v1 for patron-to-loan matches, current status, wording, dates and permitted recipients
outputs: approved notice batch v1 and recipient list

steps.what: Send the exact approved overdue/lost-book notices to their approved individual patron recipients
inputs: approved notice batch v1 and recipient list

steps.what: Inspect actual delivery failures and disputed loan notices and resolve them or refer the case to the librarian

tasks.design: Configure the circulation system in {OTHER} to filter current loan states, render native notice templates and send a reviewed version-bound batch. The technician checks the complete patron/message mapping before release and handles actual delivery and dispute exceptions; existing scheduled notices earn no new saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Staff may assemble and send notices individually from circulation records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native circulation filters, templates and batch release can replace repeated selection and individual sending.
tasks.still_hard: Wrong contacts, disputed returns and sensitive patron circumstances need human resolution.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve an erroneous or inappropriate notice without treating the loan record as infallible.

ambition.what: No new fines, debt collection or patron sanctions.

tasks.altitude: Less repetitive notice preparation where it is still manual.

reach.learn: Suppression and escalation policy for exceptional patron cases

evidence.claim: Native circulation notices can merge actual loan fields and release an approved batch to individual recipients.

assumptions: Boundary includes notice selection, writing, sending and delivery exceptions, not changing loan status or imposing charges. Shares are provisional and describe a manual notice workflow; if already scheduled, runtime is not a labour baseline.

Circulation staff already record actual item/patron IDs, checkout, due date, return/lost status; patron registration supplies the contact and permitted channel. The rule owner supplies intervals and suppression conditions. Missing or disputed data are checked manually in s1/s5.

s2 creates the completed actual message/recipient mapping before s3 approval. s4 retains operator batch selection and delivery-result checking; its reduction concerns actual individual sends today, not an ordinary save.

Recheck loan status at release. Changed status, recipient or message invalidates approval and returns the affected notice to review. No new contact-update or escalation send is automated; such actions keep their own gate if present.
unknowns: Actual proportion of invalid contacts or disputed loans
research_questions: Is current notice labour individual preparation and sending, or only exception review?

already_counted.description: Check candidate circulation and contact exceptions
Approve exact message and recipient mapping
Operate approved release and inspect delivery results
Resolve actual delivery and loan disputes

incremental.description: Maintain suppression rules and notice-template tests

approvals.approved_version: notice batch v1 and individual recipient mapping

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central 15 selection plus 21 drafting plus 8 real sending points less 2 upkeep = 42. Low assumes native notices already perform routine selection and sending and no additional configuration is adopted; existing runtime never earns labour credit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Retrieve central records for local library storage.

steps.what: Identify the required central database records and check the correct works, editions, source permissions and intended local collection
Retrieve the selected information and metadata from the central databases into a local import preview
Prepare local field mappings, preserve source provenance and identify duplicate or incompatible retrieved records
Check the exact local import payload v1 for source identity, field fidelity, edition, provenance, duplicates and intended local storage destination
Import the exact approved payload v1 into the library's local computer record store

tasks.design: Test the library system's native central-record retrieval and import preview in {OTHER}. Reuse explicit record identifiers and approved field mappings, then have the technician inspect the completed payload and its exceptions before the separate local import; no model is needed for fixed fields.
tasks.previous_blocker: Staff can retrieve records one by one and remap repeated fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record connectors and import previews can reuse explicit identifiers and mappings.
tasks.still_hard: Edition mismatches, duplicate records and source-use restrictions require checking.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when a retrieved record represents a different manifestation of the work.

ambition.what: No automatic catalogue replacement or new access rights.

tasks.altitude: Less repetitive retrieval and field preparation; source selection and acceptance remain.

evidence.claim: Native catalogue retrieval and import preview can reuse selected central records and explicit field mappings.

assumptions: Boundary includes source selection, actual retrieval, preparation, checking and local storage. Shares are provisional, not a measured import baseline.

Central cataloguers produce record identifier, author/title, publisher/date, edition, identifiers and provenance. The technician checks actual work and allowed use in s1; missing fields are manually resolved in s2-s4, never inferred from a similar record.

The local catalogue owner supplies field mapping, identifier matching and duplicate policy. {OTHER} means central bibliographic databases and the local library record system. Native configuration is tested first; unsupported sources remain manual.

s4 approves the completed exact payload and destination. Changes void approval. No saving is assigned to the final import click or existing connector runtime; the reduction is repeated retrieval and mapping work today.
unknowns: Consistency of central identifiers and local mappings
research_questions: How many retrieved records need manual edition or duplicate resolution?

already_counted.description: Check retrieval results and handle unavailable records

incremental.description: Maintain central-source connector and local field-mapping tests

approvals.approved_version: local import payload v1 and destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central 26 repeated-retrieval plus 12 mapping points less 1.5 upkeep = 36.5. Low assumes unsupported sources and inconsistent identifiers keep most work manual; source identity and final acceptance retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Verify bibliographical data against actual materials.

steps.what: Inspect the actual material's title page or equivalent and capture author, title, publisher, publication date, edition and identifiers
Find actual catalogue or publisher records for the same work and edition using the observed identifiers and title details
Compare author, title, publisher, publication date and edition field by field and resolve mismatches against the actual material
Record and check the actual bibliographic verification result and any unresolved edition or source discrepancy
Save the exact checked bibliographic verification record v1 in the internal catalogue work record

tasks.design: Configure native catalogue identifier search and side-by-side field comparison in {OTHER}. Explicit normalisation can flag matches and differences, but the technician inspects the actual material and resolves edition or meaning conflicts before recording and saving the result; no model is needed for these fixed fields.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated identifier searches and visual field comparisons consume time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue lookup and field comparison can show exact differences.
tasks.still_hard: Reprints, editions, transliteration and incomplete source records need direct inspection.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a misleading match despite similar title and author strings.

ambition.what: No automatic catalogue correction or publication.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated field comparison; material identity remains the technician's responsibility.

reach.learn: Edition and manifestation distinctions in bibliographic description

evidence.claim: Native identifier lookup and deterministic field comparison can support verification of actual bibliographic observations.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual inspection, reference lookup, comparison and the verification record. Catalogue correction and publication are separate actions, not free consequences. Shares are provisional.

The technician captures actual author/title/publisher/date/edition/identifiers in s1; source cataloguers or publishers supply comparison records. Missing identifiers require manual search in s2, and ambiguous matches stay manual in s3.

The catalogue owner supplies exact punctuation/case normalisation and matching rules; edition differences are never normalised away. {OTHER} means library catalogue and publisher/reference catalogue access. Native capabilities are tested first.
No free scanning or extraction is assumed. s4 records the actual result before approving its save; edits void approval. Same-system save and existing runtime earn no saving.
unknowns: Proportion of identifier matches that resolve to the actual edition
research_questions: Which discrepancies are formatting differences and which change bibliographic identity?

already_counted.description: Check catalogue record identity and unresolved searches
Write and check actual verification result

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central 13.5 lookup plus 15 comparison points less 1 upkeep = 27.5. Low assumes unusual editions and incomplete records leave most lookup and comparison manual; actual inspection and result authorship retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Repeated acquisition, notice and catalogue operations can shrink while actual-material checks, financial control and patron exceptions remain.
reach: Librarians and Media Collections Specialists: connect accurate technical records to collection and circulation decisions
role.ambitious_version: A library technician who keeps acquisitions, notices and local records accurate while making repeat operations easier to check.
